COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
WPSS/188/2026
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
Mr. D.S.Patni, learned Senior Counsel, 
assisted by Mr. Dharmendra Barthwal, learned 
counsel for the petitioner. 
2. Mr. Rajeev Singh Bisht, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State. 
3. The petitioner has filed the instant Writ 
Petition with the following prayers:
“i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of 
certiorari quashing the oral rejection of the petitioner (as 
done by the Counselling Committee for the respondent 
no. 4 during the counselling held by it on 12.01.2026) 
from the office of the respondent no. 4 and quashing the 
name insofar as the rejection of the petitioner’s 
candidature is concerned. 
ii) Issue a writ, order or direction the nature of 
mandamus directing the respondents to forthwith 
consider the petitioner’s candidature for her selection in 
the selection process initiated by means of 
advertisement dated 07.11.2025 afresh and 
accordingly verify petitioner’s documents as per the 
original advertisement as well as the documents
required as per amended instructions issued by
respondent no. 4 on 11.01.2026 and to appoint her to 
the post of Assistant Teacher (primary) in the Aft 
Category (General Female Seat) with all consequential 
benefits, including back wages and seniority. (contained 
as annexure no.2 to the writ petition.)
iii) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of 
mandamus thereby restraining the respondents from 
filing at least one vacancy (of Assistant Teachers 
(Primary) Category-General (Arts) and to reserve one 
post of assistant Teacher (Primary) Category- General 
(Arts) for the petitioner till the pendency of the instant 
writ petition.”
4. Counsel for the petitioner submits that in 
pursuance to the advertisement issued on 
07.11.2025 by the respondent no. 4, the 
petitioner being eligible applied for the post of 
Assistant Teacher (Primary) and her name was 
included in the merit list published by the  2026:UHC:656
respondents. Counsel for the petitioner submits 
that petitioner appeared for documents 
verification on 12.01.2026 along with downloaded 
mark-sheet and certificate of D.El.Ed, as per the 
Uttarakhand Teachers Recruitment Rules and the 
advertisement dated 07.11.2025, however on 
11.01.2026 a list of amended instructions were 
issued and on the basis of the said Counselling
Committee rejected the petitioner’s candidature
on the ground that the additional documents were 
not produced by her. Learned counsel for the 
petitioner submits that she submitted a 
representation on 16.01.2026 with the prayer that 
the new additional documents as required are 
available however no heed was paid on the said 
representation. He also refers to an order dated 
23.01.2026 passed by the Coordinate Bench of 
this Court in WPSS No. 145 of 2026, wherein in 
similar circumstances an opportunity was 
granted to the petitioner to produce the original 
certificates and the relevant documents before the 
respondents. 
5. In the interest of justice, the petitioner is 
granted one more opportunity to produce the 
original certificates and the relevant documents 
before the respondent no.4. The petitioner shall 
appear before the respondent no.4 on 30.01.2026 
at 11:00 A.M. along with original certificates and 
the other relevant documents, whereupon the 
respondents shall consider the petitioner’s 
candidature in accordance with law and if found 
in order and eligible, her name shall be included 
in the further selection process as per her merit 
and Recruitment Rules. 
6. The writ petition stands ordered 
accordingly. 
 (Subhash Upadhyay, J.)
 Vacation Judge 
 28.01.2026

COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
WPSs No. 188 of 2026 
Hon'ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
1. Mr. Dharmendra Barthwal, learned 
counsel for the petitioner. 
2. Mr. M.S.Bisht, learned Standing Counsel 
for the State. 
3. Clarification Application No. 2 of 2026 
filed by the petitioner is taken on record.
 
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner 
submits that vide order dated 28.01.2026, the 
petitioner was granted one more opportunity 
to produce the original certificates and 
relevant documents before the respondent no. 
4. The petitioner was permitted to appear on 
30.01.2026 at 11:00 A.M. along with original 
certificates and relevant documents, 
whereupon the said respondents were directed 
to consider the petitioner’s candidature, in 
accordance with law, and if found in order of 
eligibility, the name of the petitioner was to be 
included in the further selection process as 
per her Merits and Recruitment Rules. 
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that the respondent no. 4 instead of  considering the case of the petitioner, who 
was much higher in merit had given 
appointment to the candidates who are lower 
in merit than the petitioner and has not 
considered the case of the petitioner. 
6. Learned State counsel shall seek 
instructions from the District Education 
Officer (Elementary Education), Uttarkashi as 
to why the case of the petitioner was not 
considered despite the fact that she was more 
meritorious than the persons, who were given 
appointment. The said respondent shall also 
clarify as to when the selection process was 
concluded and when the appointment letters 
were issued to the candidates said to be below 
in merit than the petitioner. 
7. List on 5th June, 2026. 
(Subhash Upadhyay, J.)

COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
UKHC010013622026
WPSS/188/2026
Alka Chauhan --Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand & Others --Respondents
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
1. Heard Mr. Dharmendra Barthwal, learned 
counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Ganga Singh 
Negi, learned Additional CSC for the State.
2. This Court on 28.01.2026, passed an order 
by which the petitioner was granted one more 
opportunity to produce the original certificates 
and the relevant documents before the 
respondent no.4. The petitioner was directed to 
appear before the respondent no.4 on 30.01.2026 
at 11:00 a.m. along with original certificates and 
other relevant documents, whereupon the 
respondents were directed to consider the 
petitioner’s candidature in accordance with law 
and if found in order and eligible, her name shall 
be included in the further selection process as per 
her merit and Recruitment Rules. 
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits 
that she appeared before the said Authority. 
However, the respondent no.4 has not considered 
the case of the petitioner, who is much higher in 
the merit list, as compared to the 16 candidates 
who are lower in the merit. This Court vide order 
dated 29.05.2026 directed the District Education 
Officer (Elementary Education), Uttarkashi to  show cause as to why the case of the petitioner 
was not considered despite the fact that she was 
more meritorious than the persons, who were 
given appointment. The District Education Officer 
has filed an affidavit on 09.06.2026, wherein he 
has admitted the fact that the appointment letter 
was signed on 26.01.2026. He submits that the 
selection process was completed on 12.01.2026. 
However, on the same affidavit, he admits that 
the candidates who were given time to submit 
their original certificates, their selection was kept 
in provisional category and appointment letters 
were not issued to certain candidates. The 
District Selection Committee which held its 
meeting on 06.03.2026, decided that opportunity 
be given to the concerned persons and 15 days 
time was granted to provide the records relating
to their residence certificate. It is further stated 
that till date the records were not provided by 
them and appointment letters were not issued to 
the said candidates. The averments made in para 
11 of the said affidavit read as under:-
“That the candidates who were given time had 
already been selected by the selection committee on 
12.01.2026 and when the records were verified 
again at the office level, it was found that the 
concerned candidates had submitted their original 
certificates on 12.01.2026, the date of verification of 
original certificates, but the certificates regarding 
their own or their guardian's residence outside 
Uttarakhand for livelihood/studies while undergoing 
D.El.Ed training from Uttar Pradesh were not made 
available by the concerned. candidates, due to which 
their selection was kept in the provisional category 
and appointment orders were not issued, because in 
the meeting of the District Selection Committee held 
on 06.03.2026, it was decided by the Selection 
Committee to provide an opportunity to the concerned 
persons and give them 15 days time to provide the 
records related to their residence, but even till date 
the records were not provided by them and 
appointment letters were not issued to them.  True/correct typed version/copy of letter dated 
6.3.2026 is being filed herewith and marked as 
Annexure No.2 to this affidavit.”
4. Thus, it is an admitted fact that the 
selection process had not come to an end and 
Selection Committee had provided 15 days time 
to the said candidates to provide the records.
5. On the contrary, the case of the petitioner is 
that she had submitted her documents on 
30.01.2026. Despite the fact that 16 candidates 
who are lower in the merit to the petitioner have 
been given appointment, the case of the petitioner 
has not been considered. As there are still three 
posts vacant, as the said candidates have failed to 
appear within 15 days as directed by the District 
Selection Committee on 06.03.2026 and 16 
persons who are less meritorious to the petitioner 
have been given appointment, the District 
Education Officer (Elementary Education), 
Uttarkashi shall consider the case of the 
petitioner for appointment and shall submit an 
affidavit to the said effect on the decision been 
taken. District Education Officer (Elementary 
Education), Uttarkashi shall also clarify that why 
the 16 persons, who were lower in the merit than 
the petitioner, have been given appointment
without considering the case of the petitioner.
6. List on 11.09.2026 after fresh.
 (Subhash Upadhyay,J.)
